input.transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling. Can I get your name please?
Customer: Sure, my name is Alex Johnson.
Agent: And what seems to be the issue today?
Customer: I placed an order on March 5th for a laptop. The order number is 78432. It was supposed to arrive in 3 days but it has been 10 days and I still haven't received it.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into order 78432. I can see it was shipped on March 6th via FedEx with tracking number FX998123. It appears there was a delay at the regional hub. I'll escalate this and you should receive it within 2 business days.
Customer: Thank you.
input.summary: Customer Alex Johnson called about order 78432 placed on March 5th for a laptop. The order was shipped on March 6th via FedEx (tracking FX998123) but was delayed at the regional hub. Agent escalated the issue and advised delivery within 2 business days.

label.notes: Summary fully and accurately reflects all facts in the transcript.
